description.value: Big Way Hot Pot is a growing Chinese hot pot chain offering an individual self-serve dining experience with over 100 premium ingredients and more than 18 broths, from rich Signature Mala to light Tomato with vegan options. The Kingsway location in Burnaby is one of several BC outposts in a chain that now spans across Canada and into the US. Diners select their own broth and cook ingredients tableside in individual pots.
